correctness.rationale: For T=C_phi-C_psi on scalar l_infty, each output row after deleting finite input coordinates F has norm precisely the sum of its two surviving weighted point-evaluation norms; the upper compact bound is the finite-rank TP_F estimate. To get the reverse bound for arbitrary compact perturbations choose row witnesses with pairwise disjoint finite supports outside increasing F_n. Their bounded normalized input vectors are weakly null in l_infty because sum of signed disjoint vectors has uniformly bounded norm; any compact K maps them to norm-null outputs. Thus the essential norm is exactly inf_F H(F), independent of local finiteness or repetition of symbols. For unweighted pairs, H(F) is 0,1,2 by finite edges/finite vertex cover/no finite vertex cover. Greedy maximal matching shows absence of finite cover iff existence of an infinite matching. Proper c_0 symbols give finite graph degree, so infinite edges force 2; each finite edge set has finite rank. Approximation-number bounds follow since essential norm <= every finite-rank distance; the cover truncation has rank <=|F|. All fields real or complex, positive weights with separate bounded compositions. This is not a theorem about arbitrary cancellation-only maps on c_0. Independent finite row/graph checks and repeated-edge rank-one sanity check corroborate, but the weak-null proof supplies the infinite argument.

originality.rationale: Discrete coordinate essential norms of differences are a natural variation of individual composition-operator norms. A highly relevant same-space 2022 source even states a 0/1/2 classification in terms of symbol ranges and infinitely many disagreeing output indices; that condition does not distinguish repeated disagreement pairs. In a repeated-edge example both symbols can have infinite ranges and differ on infinitely many input indices while T has rank one, refuting a naive unconditional implication of the printed criterion; the present distinct-pair graph cures that multiplicity defect. The weighted tail identity and c0/proper formulation further distinguish the specific claim. Novelty is best-of-knowledge: a correct older matrix-operator theorem could imply the tail formula.
